decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Covering letter, 654.19.01, 12012/TP/206, 12012/TP/205, 12012/TP/204, 12012/TP/203, 12012/TP/202, 12012/TP/201, 12012/TP/200, design and access statement dated 25/09/2014, Heras UK fencing systems Pallas Xtra System specification received on 29/09/2014 and tree survey 581/10/01 Revision A received on 07/10/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All existing trees shall be retained, unless shown on the approved drawing 654.19.01 as being removed. All trees on and immediately adjoining the site shall be protected from damage as a result of works on the site in accordance with relevant British Standard (BS 5837: 1991), for the duration of the works on site and until at least five years following contractual practical completion of the approved development. In the event that trees become damaged or otherwise defective during such period, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified as soon as reasonably practicable and remedial action agreed and implemented. In the event that any tree dies or is removed without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority, it shall be replaced as soon as is reasonably practicable and, in any case, by not later than the end of the first available planting season, with trees of such size, species and in such number and positions as may be agreed with the Authority.

Condition : 4 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority
description: Alterations to the exterior of building, including erection of a new entrance canopy with external lighting, replacement of first floor glazing band and recladding of external fascia, new personnel and loading doors including a cantilevered canopy, and erection of a 2.4m weldmesh security fencing around perimeter of loading area with pedestrian gate and cantilevered sliding gate for vehicular access
